decisions.evidence: Candidate C1 failed to identify the specific US$27.7 billion total debt burden [D02], instead citing 'US$27.7 billion in debt claims' [L76] without reconciling the consolidated versus unconsolidated portions [D02]. Furthermore, it improperly classifies the investment as a simple restructuring rather than the distressed equity exception required by GGP's specific liquidity crisis [L99, D08].
decisions.fix: The model should have correctly distinguished between consolidated debt and at-share unconsolidated debt to confirm true asset coverage [D02, D04] and acknowledged the specific legal constraints of Chapter 11 [D09] rather than generic restructuring terminology.

notes: Candidate C1 shows a solid grasp of the distressed nature of GGP but fails to meet the strict evidence-based requirements of the Pershing Square agent. Specifically, it confuses the debt structure, which is critical for evaluating the residual equity case [D02, D04]. The inclusion of leadership change as a primary driver [L59] is also imprecise compared to the urgent, specific task of refinancing/restructuring [D03, D07].
